# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighteen years old in her Freshman year at Redmond College; around twenty-two at graduation.  <sub>[v3 c1 P15](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0015), [v3 c4 P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), [v3 c37 P9](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher and former student; went on a mission or work in Japan.  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v3 c30 P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Pris  <sub>[v3 c4 P16](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0016)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is a tall, pale, and spiritual-looking maiden with an airy, slender figure. She has a high intellect and a thoughtful, dream-like aura. Despite her delicate appearance, she considers herself rather tall and once worried she looked like an 'overgrown sample of a potato-fed Islander' next to others.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v3 c4 P12](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0012), [v3 c34 P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 c35 P4](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Priscilla is a pale, spiritual-looking girl who is secretly full to the brim of mischief, pranks, and fun. She has a dry, humorous wit and a practical streak alongside her love for literature. A loyal and affectionate chum, she shares a deep bond of friendship with Anne Shirley and Stella Maynard. She is deeply appreciative of the beauty in nature and poetry, yet remains sensible and grounded.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P10](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0010), [v3 c9 P17](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0017), [v3 c13 P18](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0018), [v3 c35 P4](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0004)_

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's Academy with Anne Shirley, after which she taught school at Carmody for a time. She resigned her post to attend Redmond College in Kingsport, joining Anne, Gilbert Blythe, and Charlie Sloane. During her first year at Redmond, she lived in a St. John Street boardinghouse with Anne and quickly struck up a close friendship with Philippa Gordon. In their Sophomore year, Priscilla, Anne, Philippa, and Stella Maynard rented Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue, keeping house together under the chaperonage of Stella's Aunt Jamesina. Priscilla pursued a course in Classics, eventually graduating with Honors. Following her time at Redmond, she went to Japan.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c3 P17](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0017), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c36 P11](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0011), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_
